answer: Random mutual audit pairs strangers to check each other's work, so a fake identity cannot survive on paperwork alone. Each epoch, a random pair must re-run each other's claimed task and must forge a signed joint record. A failed audit leaves a violet mark on the public record, and two marks freeze the identity. The kth fake identity still needs its own passed audit and a 20-token bond, so 1,000 fakes risk 20,000 tokens while an honest agent risks one bond. Audit-ring collusion is blocked by secret pairing, and disputed audits rise to a summit review of five auditors.
